kill_history.detail: Spearman(core6, median_margin) = +1.00, exact p = 0.0028; Spearman(core6, frac<0.005) = -1.00, exact p = 0.0028 -- both at n=6 exact-permutation lower bound

kill_history.downgrade_reason: The ladder confounds damage level with training budget, so neither a positive nor a negative correlation over it is attributable to damage. Among the 5 damaged rungs: Spearman(core6, heal_steps) = +0.8944 while Spearman(core6, layers_kept) = -0.3536 -- budget outranks damage AND has the better sign. layers_kept takes only TWO values across damaged rungs (14 at four rungs, 16 at one), so there is almost no damage-depth rank variation to correlate. Holding damage completely constant inside the f12k2/14L cell still spans core6 0.3848 -> 0.4632 (spread 0.0783) purely on 2k vs 20k vs 200k steps, which is 66.1% of the 0.1185 spread across all five damaged rungs. The step20000 non-monotonicity that the original verdict called the story-breaker sits exactly on that budget axis.
kill_history.detail: Original measurement retained and unchanged: same metrics on the Qwen3-8B six-rung ladder give rho = +0.43 (p=0.42) and -0.49 (p=0.36) vs OLMo's +-1.00 (exact p=0.0028). Rungs are still core6-ordered, so aggregate degradation replicates. What is withdrawn is the INFERENCE that the rho collapse shows damage failing to compress per-item margins.
kill_history.only_damage_attributable_contrast: the equal-budget slice at 2000 steps (f12k2/14L, f12k4/16L, scratch14L) -- n=3, exact-permutation two-sided minimum p = 2/6 = 0.3333, so it cannot reach significance at any conventional alpha regardless of the data, and it varies two architectural factors at once. Neither confirms nor kills.
kill_history.consequence: Cross-family generality is now UNTESTED, not refuted. This is NOT a promotion -- see status_note_2026_08_10.

status_note_2026_08_10.status_unchanged: NARROWED_TO_OLMO_2_ONLY -- removing a failed kill does not manufacture a successful replication. Before the downgrade cross-family generality was refuted; after it, untested. Both are equally far from established, and 'untested' is not a promotion argument. The hold_in_backlog novelty verdict of 2026-08-09 is unaffected.
status_note_2026_08_10.olmo_leg_is_less_confounded_not_unconfou: Disclosed for symmetry: the OLMo ladder is also budget-varying -- Spearman(core6, heal_steps) = +0.8721 across its 5 damaged rungs (steps 83500/121000/124000/200000). The difference that licenses its claim is that OLMo's damage depth spans FIVE distinct values (8/10/12/14/16) and is a PERFECT rank predictor of core6 (rho = +1.0000), i.e. it has a real damage axis, whereas Qwen's damage depth spans two values and predicts worse than budget. Wherever the OLMo rho=+1.00 is quoted, the +0.8721 budget correlation should be quoted with it.
status_note_2026_08_10.qwen_readmitted_as_candidate_family: The prior resurrection condition said 'NOT Qwen; that has already failed'. That clause is WITHDRAWN because Qwen was never fairly tested. Qwen is re-admitted, but only via a matched ladder meeting the six conditions in the addendum's section 6.
matched_ladder_requirements: budget held constant across damaged rungs; report Spearman(core6, heal_steps) ~ 0 alongside the headline rho
>=4 distinct damage levels so layers_kept has real rank variation (OLMo's 8/10/12/14/16 is the shape to match)
one damage axis at a time -- do not vary fresh-block width and init inside the correlation ladder
n >= 6 rungs to keep the exact-permutation two-sided floor at 2/720 = 0.0028
identical harness and identical item set across rungs (existing runs already satisfy this: n=17195 each, per-item norm_scores asserted)
reuse the already-designated PRIMARY metric frac(margin<0.005); do not pick post hoc among the four thresholds
status_note_2026_08_10.cost_note: The budget-matching requirement means re-healing Qwen rungs to a common step count rather than reusing existing checkpoints. This downgrade does NOT authorise that spend; it records what the spend would buy. B04 stays in backlog, so there is no reason to run it before the mechanism-level hypothesis exists.
status_note_2026_08_10.disclosure: No new threshold was invented. +0.8944 and the 0.661 within-cell ratio are descriptive statistics of the existing design, not tests against a cutoff. The judgement -- that a correlation better explained by a nuisance factor than by the factor of interest cannot license a claim about the factor of interest -- was made AFTER seeing the data, on 2026-08-10, by re-reading an already-published verdict. The original gate design should have required the matching conditions up front and did not.

olmo_only_finding.claim: On the OLMo-2-7B keepN + shortgpt16 ladder, aggregate core6 degradation is accompanied by per-item acc_norm margin compression. Both Spearman metrics hit the n=6 exact-permutation lower bound.
olmo_only_finding.scope: OLMo-2-7B specifically; cross-family generality is UNTESTED as of 2026-08-10 (the Qwen leg that previously refuted it is now NON_MATCHED_INCONCLUSIVE)
olmo_only_finding.budget_caveat_2026_08_10: This ladder is not budget-matched either: Spearman(core6, heal_steps) = +0.8721 across its 5 damaged rungs. It is defensible because damage depth spans 5 values and is a PERFECT rank predictor (rho = +1.0000), unlike Qwen's. Quote the +0.8721 whenever the +1.00 is quoted.
olmo_only_finding.recommended_home: fold into Paper B methods appendix or the A01 null-cal spin-out; not stand-alone-paper material

novelty_check_2026_08_09.kill_definition: A paper is a kill iff it (1) uses depth-prune-then-heal (not just prune-only or attention-only) on >=3 rungs, (2) reports per-item acc_norm (or equivalent length-normalized) margin distribution on MC tasks, AND (3) reports either median_margin or frac(margin<threshold) co-varying with aggregate score on that ladder. None of the top-5 or also-noted set satisfies all three. Concurrent (<=3mo, arXiv only) same-lens work on a different family is NOT a kill.
